summary: Bare dirt clearing in bush just off Mount Nebo Road, nobody close.
reasons: Bare dirt pad fits a van
Nearest building 48 m, unmapped as home

drivers.seclusion: Thick forest on all sides; one building 48 m away, mapped as non-dwelling.
drivers.access_and_room: Bare dirt pad of van length, reaching the road edge by a short cut, probably a short spur.
drivers.traffic: Quiet mountain road about 20 m away, screened by trees.
drivers.convention: No vehicles or campers visible; pad looks like a lookout or break access.

flags: Steep ground around the pad: up to 12% mean grade nearby
Building 48 m northeast may be a house or hut
Link from road to pad is hidden by trees
sun_shade: Mostly tree shade from the east and south; open overhead.
cannot_judge: Whether the pad's entrance is passable for 2WD

best_section.where: Cleared dirt pad at the pin, just southwest of the road bend
